items.content:
THE COMMODITY PRICE SUPER CYCLE IS FAR FROM OVER.  

 x.com/thierryborgeat/status/… Thierry from arvy 🇨🇭 (@ThierryBorgeat)Major peaks roughly every thirty years: 1920, 1950, 1980,  2008 … and the next window around 2038–2040. 

Which puts us in the  early-to-middle innings of the up-leg.

Major commodity peaks have arrived roughly every thirty years: 1920, 1950, 1980, 2008. Space those out and the next great commodity peak lands somewhere around 2038–2040 — which means we  are, right now, in the early-to-middle innings of the up-leg toward it.  The momentum divergence at the base of that chart, turning up after  decades, is the tell that the new commodity cycle has already begun.—  https://x.com/ThierryBorgeat/status/2092331174257480134
